note: Set A is better because it correctly extracts the steel density and shear modulus values, whereas Set B includes claims with significant numerical errors (e.g., 785E3 kg/m³ instead of 7.85E3 kg/m³). Both sets incorrectly state the tower's first natural frequency as 0.18 Hz instead of 0.170 Hz and misformat the Young's modulus value (200E11 vs 2.00E11). However, Set B introduces additional unsupported numerical values for material properties, making it less reliable overall.
